tasks.title: Explain included context and safe exclusions
tasks.objective: Assert that context packets expose item explanations, source links, review actions, feedback rank components, and payload-safe exclusion summaries.

toolCalls.purpose: Retrieve Project A CTO context through the productized context packet surface.

query.q: Project A CTO guidance migration risk delivery sequencing security boundaries

expectedResponseSignals: context includes the Project A SQL-first Npgsql decision
included items expose explanation.primaryReason and bounded matchedSignals
excluded contains withheld not_authorized and sensitive summaries

tasks.title: Avoid stale and redacted benchmark overlay memory
tasks.objective: Assert that the benchmark overlay exposes inactive state as metadata without reviving superseded or redacted memory as current context.

toolCalls.purpose: Find the current Project A migration decision and related inactive overlay facts.
expectedResponseSignals: facts include the active Project A SQL-first Npgsql decision
superseded overlay memory is contradiction or exclusion metadata only
redacted overlay content is not returned
inactive and redacted-or-deleted exclusion counters remain metadata

tasks.title: Apply payload-safe missing feedback as a ranking signal
tasks.objective: Assert before-and-after context ranking behavior for packet-level missing feedback without storing or echoing raw query text.

toolCalls.purpose: Capture the before-feedback context packet for a run-unique query.
expectedResponseSignals: Project A decision item is present before feedback
feedbackAdjustment is captured as the baseline rank component

toolCalls.purpose: Record packet-level missing feedback using the query hash path.
expectedResponseSignals: raw query text is not returned

toolCalls.purpose: Capture the after-feedback context packet for the same query.
expectedResponseSignals: feedbackAdjustment is lower after missing feedback
rank changes remain bounded and payload-safe
